articles.summary: AI coding agents are already writing your code. The question is whether they run in a contained, auditable system or loose on a developer's machine. Learn how Release's BYOC Kubernetes environments, per-agent isolation, and PR-gated workflows give platform and security leaders real containment, not just a promise.
articles.title: Hardening Your AI Agents: Run Them in Your Own Kubernetes Cluster, Not on a Laptop or in a Vendor Black Box

articles.summary: Claude Code moves fast. Without a QA team, the validation gap falls on you. Here's how solo developers and small teams wire Claude Code to Release's ephemeral environments so they can actually exercise every PR — click the UI, hit the endpoint, watch the migration run — before merging, not just read the diff and hope.
articles.title: The One-Developer Review Loop: Validating What Claude Code Built, Without a QA Team
